# busbar <VERSION> config, migrated by `busbar --migrate-config`.
# The items below need a decision; `busbar --validate` must pass.
# TODO(migrate): auth.chain: the static-token allowlist is GONE in 1.5.0; every caller needs a minted signed key (POST /api/v1/admin/keys) - 1.x bearer tokens stop working
# TODO(migrate): auth.client_tokens removed: static tokens are gone in 1.5.0; mint signed keys for each caller (POST /api/v1/admin/keys)

listen: 0.0.0.0:8080
pools:
  glm:
    members:
    - weight: 1
      model: glm-5.1
    - weight: 1
      model: glm-4.6
    - weight: 1
      model: glm-4.5
  hindsight:
    members:
    - weight: 1
      model: glm-5.1
    - weight: 1
      model: glm-4.6
    - weight: 1
      model: glm-4.5
providers:
  z.ai:
    api_key:
      env: ZAI_KEY
models:
  glm-4.5:
    provider: z.ai
    max_concurrent: 10
    max_requests: -1
  glm-5.1:
    provider: z.ai
    max_concurrent: 10
    max_requests: -1
  glm-4.6:
    provider: z.ai
    max_concurrent: 3
    max_requests: -1
auth:
  chain:
  - keys

effects.stderr:
migrated 'tests/migration-corpus/from-tags/v0.12.0_config.yaml' to the 1.5.0 config shape.

CHANGES (9):
  - auth.client_tokens removed (static tokens are gone)
  - auth.mode: token -> auth.chain: [keys] (static tokens are removed; mint signed keys)
  - pools.glm.members[].target -> model
  - pools.glm.members[].target -> model
  - pools.glm.members[].target -> model
  - pools.hindsight.members[].target -> model
  - pools.hindsight.members[].target -> model
  - pools.hindsight.members[].target -> model
  - providers.z.ai.api_key_env -> api_key: { env: ... }

  * auth.chain: the static-token allowlist is GONE in 1.5.0; every caller needs a minted signed key (POST /api/v1/admin/keys) - 1.x bearer tokens stop working
  * auth.client_tokens removed: static tokens are gone in 1.5.0; mint signed keys for each caller (POST /api/v1/admin/keys)

Review the output, then run `busbar --validate` on it before deploying.                  NOTE: 1.x virtual keys do not carry over - mint fresh signed keys (the 1.5.0                  security headline: keys now expire).
